summary: Completed testing of Seeker Offers page. Fixed critical bug in PUT /api/hiring/offers/{id}/respond endpoint (datetime comparison error). All features working: offer list display, Accept/Decline buttons, review dialog, status updates.

fixed.issue: TypeError: can't compare offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes at line 3045
fixed.fix: Updated datetime parsing to handle date-only strings (YYYY-MM-DD) by adding timezone info, same fix as GET endpoint

passed_tests: Seeker Offers page (/seeker/offers) loads and shows offer list

Offer card shows: job title (ICU Travel Nurse), facility (VitalaMatch Medical Center), location (Los Angeles, CA), pay ($55/hourly), start date (4/15/2026), specialty (Registered Nurse (RN) - ICU/Critical Care), status (Accepted)
Offer card shows benefits summary and conditions as badges
Offer expiration date is displayed for pending offers
Accept and Decline buttons are visible on pending offers only
Clicking Accept/Decline opens a review dialog with offer summary, expiration warning, and notes field
Accepting an offer via PUT /api/hiring/offers/{id}/respond with accepted=true updates status to 'accepted'
Declining an offer via PUT /api/hiring/offers/{id}/respond with accepted=false updates status to 'rejected'
After accepting, the offer card shows 'Accepted' badge and no action buttons
After declining, the offer card shows 'Declined' badge and 'Declined on' date
Seeker dashboard Offers count updates after accepting/declining (shows 0 pending)
GET /api/seeker/applications endpoint correctly reflects offer status (accepted/declined)
GET /api/hiring/offers returns enriched offer data with job.location and job.specialty
Pending alert banner shows when there are pending offers
Toast notifications appear after accepting/declining offers

success_rate.backend: 100% - 10 passed, 2 skipped (no pending offers to test accept/decline after UI tests consumed them)
